name: pa2_pairwise_evaluation
description: Pairwise judging for PA2 SFT, DPO and Persona outputs
definition:
@kbench.task(
    name="pa2_pairwise_evaluation",
    description="Pairwise judging for PA2 SFT, DPO and Persona outputs",
)
def pa2_pairwise_evaluation(llm):
    ultra_output = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "ultrafeedback_dpo_vs_sft_judged.jsonl",
    )

    judge_pairwise_file(
        llm,
        ULTRAFEEDBACK_PAIRS,
        ultra_output,
        "ultrafeedback",
    )

    hh_output = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "hh_dpo_vs_sft_judged.jsonl",
    )

    judge_pairwise_file(
        llm,
        HH_PAIRS,
        hh_output,
        "hh",
    )

    persona_output = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "persona_lora_vs_base_judged.jsonl",
    )

    judge_pairwise_file(
        llm,
        PERSONA_PAIRS,
        persona_output,
        "persona",
    )

    summary = {
        "ultrafeedback": summarize_results(
            ultra_output,
            "ultrafeedback",
        ),
        "hh": summarize_results(
            hh_output,
            "hh",
        ),
        "persona": summarize_results(
            persona_output,
            "persona",
        ),
    }

    summary_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "evaluation_summary.json",
    )

    with open(
        summary_path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as file:
        json.dump(
            summary,
            file,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    # return summary
